protocol: At least ten real minutes and native frame span. Normal AutoWalk on an admitted OSM route; reversal only at its endpoint. No teleport or accelerated movement/time. Five month/profile/weather chapters use the actual select handlers. Software Chromium SwiftShader at 480×320 DPR1; not hardware or Android FPS. All src/public files immutable during this run.

allocated.method: Instrumented WebGL2 bufferData/deleteBuffer and texture storage/mipmap/delete calls. Logical storage, texture estimate with depth24 conservatively counted as 4 B/texel. Excludes driver/compression/framebuffer defaults; not physical VRAM.
